michael-romanov-elected-tsar.research_focus: the 1613 Moscow delegation to the Ipatiev Monastery, Muscovite boyar and clergy dress, and Orthodox icons
michael-romanov-elected-tsar.scene: A slight teenage boy in plain robes stands hesitant in a monastery doorway as bearded boyars in tall fur hats and clergy holding icons kneel before him in the snow

peter-and-ivan-co-tsars.research_focus: the silver double throne made for Ivan V and Peter I, the Kremlin palace interiors, and the regent Sophia
peter-and-ivan-co-tsars.scene: Two small boys in heavy brocade robes sit side by side on one double throne of silver, while a woman's shadowed face watches from a small hidden window in the throne's high back

peter-great-embassy-europe.research_focus: the Zaandam and Amsterdam shipyards of the 1690s and Peter the Great working there disguised as a carpenter
peter-great-embassy-europe.scene: A very tall young man in a shipwright's plain work clothes swings an adze at a ship's timber frame in a Dutch shipyard, other workers unaware of who he is

founding-st-petersburg.research_focus: the 1703 founding of the Peter and Paul Fortress on Hare Island in the Neva delta, and the labourers who built it
founding-st-petersburg.scene: Labourers haul logs and drive wooden piles into a reedy marsh at a wide river mouth, the earthen walls of a new star-shaped fortress rising behind them

peter-proclaimed-emperor.research_focus: the 1721 celebrations of the Peace of Nystad in St Petersburg, Petrine court and Senate dress, and imperial regalia
peter-proclaimed-emperor.scene: A towering man in a plain military coat stands at the centre of a crowded hall as bewigged senators in long coats bow low toward him; a crown and orb rest on a cushion nearby

elizabeth-seizes-russian-throne.research_focus: the night coup of 25 November 1741, the Preobrazhensky grenadiers, and Elizabeth Petrovna's appearance
elizabeth-seizes-russian-throne.scene: A young woman wearing a steel breastplate over her gown leads a column of grenadiers through snow by torchlight toward a darkened palace, one hand raised forward

russia-annexes-crimea.research_focus: the founding of Sevastopol and the Black Sea Fleet in 1783, and Crimean Tatar coastal landscapes
russia-annexes-crimea.scene: Tall-masted warships ride at anchor in a deep, sheltered Crimean bay below limestone cliffs, while soldiers raise the first buildings of a naval base on the shore

paul-i-assassinated.research_focus: the night of 11-12 March 1801 at St Michael's Castle in St Petersburg, and officers' uniforms of Paul I's reign
paul-i-assassinated.scene: A knot of officers with drawn swords and a single candle crowd at a tall bedroom door in a dark palace corridor; nothing of what happens inside is shown

decembrist-revolt.research_focus: the Decembrist uprising on Senate Square in December 1825, Russian guards uniforms of the 1820s, and the Bronze Horseman statue
decembrist-revolt.scene: Ranks of rebel soldiers stand in a square formation on a snowy city square beside a rearing equestrian statue on a great rock, facing a line of cannons across the snow

tsarskoye-selo-railway-opens.research_focus: the Tsarskoye Selo Railway of 1837, its early English-built steam locomotives and open carriages, and the Pavlovsk station
tsarskoye-selo-railway-opens.scene: A small early steam locomotive with a tall chimney pulls open carriages of top-hatted passengers through a flat birch landscape toward a classical pavilion

tolstoy-war-and-peace-completed.research_focus: Leo Tolstoy's study at Yasnaya Polyana in the 1860s and his manuscripts of War and Peace
tolstoy-war-and-peace-completed.scene: A towering stack of finished manuscript pages, seen edge-on, sits on a plain wooden writing desk by candlelight, a quill laid across the top and a window showing a snowy estate

faberge-first-imperial-egg.research_focus: the 1885 Hen Egg by Fabergé, its enamelled shell, gold yolk and hidden hen, and the Romanov court at Easter
faberge-first-imperial-egg.scene: A gloved hand opens a smooth enamelled egg to reveal a gold yolk, and nestled inside the yolk a tiny gold hen; the egg rests on a velvet cushion

trans-siberian-railway-begun.research_focus: construction of the Trans-Siberian Railway in the 1890s, its labour gangs, and the Siberian taiga and Ussuri region
trans-siberian-railway-begun.scene: Gangs of labourers lay wooden sleepers and iron rails through a clearing in dense taiga forest, the track running straight away from them into a vast empty distance

nicholas-ii-becomes-tsar.research_focus: the death of Alexander III at Livadia in 1894, the Russian imperial crown, and Orthodox mourning rites
nicholas-ii-becomes-tsar.scene: The jewelled imperial crown rests on a cushion in a candlelit palace chapel, a draped coffin and bowed mourners behind it; no faces are shown

bloody-sunday-st-petersburg.research_focus: Bloody Sunday, 9 January 1905, the workers' procession with icons and banners, and the Winter Palace square
bloody-sunday-st-petersburg.scene: A crowd of workers in winter coats carrying Orthodox icons halts in the snow before a line of soldiers with raised rifles, the long front of a palace behind; non-graphic, no bodies

russia-enters-world-war-one.research_focus: Russian mobilisation in July and August 1914, conscripts in 1914 uniforms, and railway stations of the era
russia-enters-world-war-one.scene: Columns of young soldiers with rifles and bedrolls crowd onto a long troop train at a station platform as women and children reach out to them in farewell

rasputin-murdered.research_focus: the Yusupov Palace on the Moika, the Malaya Nevka river in winter, and Petrograd in December 1916
rasputin-murdered.scene: A dark hole is broken in the ice of a frozen river beneath a bridge at night, a single fur boot lying on the ice beside it; no figures
